blocks.content: bundled-skills/ ships via electron-builder extraResources and contains six starter skills scaffolded without overwriting user copies: skill-builder, project-orientation, systematic-debugging, test-first-development, completion-review, wiki-maintenance. Plugin examples, including example-text-formatter and Document Kit, live in the repository for import and are NOT included by the current extraResources config. The formatter exposes slugify/upper and supplies a real MCP test fixture. Skill Builder's draft workflow needs reconciliation with project confinement: create in the selected project, then use UI import/validation/enable.
Uses only the app's real tools; cannot self-approve writes or execute anything.
~100 lines of pure Node NDJSON JSON-RPC: initialize, tools/list, tools/call. No network, no fs.
